recommendations.title: Rename “Description” to “Add questions”
recommendations.text: Add one line of helper text that says the teacher writes the questions here.

recommendations.title: Offer the new rubric right away
recommendations.text: After a rubric is made, show “Use this rubric for your assessment” and confirm when it’s attached. Let teachers keep refining it with AI.

recommendations.title: Put the AI Grader first and add Save
recommendations.text: Move the AI Grader above the teacher’s feedback. End the flow with a clear button to save and send to students.

recommendations.title: Put “Create a new rubric with Claire” in the dropdown
recommendations.text: Teachers then pick one option from one list.

recommendations.title: Explain “Include in Gradebook”
recommendations.text: Say what it does next to the toggle, or move it to grading. Placement needs another round of testing.

recommendations.title: Rethink the default rating scales
recommendations.text: Research the scales districts use and tailor options by subject.

recommendations.title: Write AI feedback for students
recommendations.text: Simpler words, clear next steps and an encouraging tone.

recommendations.title: Make AI feedback editable
recommendations.text: Edit it in place like a document, and save the edits.

recommendations.title: Study why Assessment is hard to find
recommendations.text: Two teachers confused it with the Teaching Aide. The cause needs more research.
